rules.name: Standard receiving
rules.problem_statement: Receipts are late, overstated, or omit the PO reference.
rules.required_behavior: Verify the PO, count goods, post the receipt immediately, record discrepancies, and close only when complete.
rules.completion_condition: A PO-linked receipt records the counted quantity and any discrepancy.
rules.escalation_condition: Discrepancy or unposted receipt remains at end of shift.

rules.name: Return reason discipline
rules.required_behavior: Record an allowed reason before treating a return as operationally complete.
rules.completion_condition: Completed return has an allowed reason code.
rules.escalation_condition: Return remains incomplete at shift close.

rules.name: Transfer closure ownership
rules.required_behavior: Sender records SENT; receiver verifies goods and records RECEIVED; central inventory reviews aged transfers.
rules.completion_condition: Receiver acknowledgement and actual quantity are recorded.
rules.escalation_condition: Central Inventory reviews an unacknowledged aged transfer.

rules.name: Canonical mapping governance
rules.problem_statement: Local aliases and delayed mappings create recurring exceptions.
rules.required_behavior: Approve canonical mappings before activation where practical and review ambiguity; local aliases are not authoritative.
rules.trigger: New supplier item or SKU proposed
rules.completion_condition: Approved canonical source contains an unambiguous mapping or documented review disposition.
rules.escalation_condition: Ambiguous or unmapped item is blocked and sent to the data steward.

rules.name: Purposeful spreadsheet use
rules.problem_statement: Managers duplicate configured reports in spreadsheets.
rules.required_behavior: Use configured BI evidence directly; retain a spreadsheet only for a documented residual purpose.
rules.completion_condition: Briefing is distributed without redundant export, copy, and reformat steps.
rules.escalation_condition: Owner reviews any parallel summary with conflicting totals.
